{{Current events|year=2003|month=06|day=20|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
* The ''[[Christian Science Monitor]]'' apologises to [[George Galloway]] for falsely alleging that he received ten million dollars from [[Saddam Hussein]].  Galloway refuses to accept the apology.
* The ''[[Houston Chronicle]]'' reports that [[Bill Sikora]], who advised [[NASA]] in 1989 on how to evade [[Freedom of Information Act (United States)|Freedom of Information Act]] requests, is  now working as legal counsel on the agency's [[Space Shuttle Columbia disaster]] investigation board.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.chron.com/cs/CDA/ssistory.mpl/space/1960571 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050308121557/http://www.chron.com/cs/CDA/ssistory.mpl/space/1960571 |archive-date=2005-03-08 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*The [[North East MRT line]] in [[Singapore]] began operations, with 14 stations of the MRT line from [[HarbourFront MRT station|HarbourFront]] to [[Punggol MRT/LRT station|Punggol]] (except [[Woodleigh MRT station|Woodleigh]] and [[Buangkok MRT station|Buangkok]]) being opened at the same time operated by [[SBS Transit|SBS Transit Ltd]] using [[Alstom Metropolis C751A]]s.
